COMPLIANCE

# Tick Every Box In Your Compliance Checklist With Aviso

We take care of your compliance obligations so you focus on selling.

## How Aviso Meets Compliance Standards

Aviso runs on AWS, has different levels of compliance and security as dictated by ISO 27001, PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1, and SOC 2 Type II. In addition, we also participate in yearly audits with third-party suppliers to ensure our offerings meet compliance requirements.

### ISO 27001

Aviso is certified with ISO 27001 and adheres to its security frameworks. As a result, the company is more resistant to cyberattacks and guarantees overall security while preserving data availability, confidentiality, and integrity.

### GDPR

Aviso has completed the internal assessment and compliance review as per GDPR regulations and has put air-tight regulations in place regarding data protection and privacy.

### SOC 2 Type II

SOC 2 Type II’s rigorous audit of Aviso’s Revenue Intelligence Platform and our results underscore our continued dedication to delivering best-in-breed compliance, robust security and protection for customer data.

### Pen Test

Aviso has completed the PEN test to audit its network with the Rapid7 organization. No major items were reported.

### Encryption and SAML SSO Compliance

Aviso is 100% SAML SSO-compliant and never receives or stores end-user passwords. In addition, it encrypts at-rest and in-transit data using AES 256-bit encryption.
